record.title: Cohomology of the moduli space of smooth quartics with a bitangent
record.statement: Let $H_{4,2}$ be the moduli space of smooth plane quartic curves, and let $H_{4,2}(1)$ be the space of smooth quartics equipped with a bitangent line; the latter is a degree-$28$ cover of $H_{4,2}$. What is $H^*(H_{4,2}(1),\mathbb{Q})$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15987), page 73. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Parity of uniformly chosen entries in the character table of $S_n$
record.statement: For $\[?]$ partitions $\[?]$ of $n$, let $\[?]$ denote the irreducible character of $S_n$ corresponding to $\[?]$. As $n\to\infty$, $$\operatorname{Prob}\bigl(\chi_\lambda(\mu)\equiv 0\pmod 2\text{ for }\lambda,\mu\vdash n\bigr)\longrightarrow 1.$$ Equivalently, an entry chosen uniformly at random from the character table of $S_n$ is even with probability tending to $1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15987), page 74. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Systems of quadratic forms over p-adic fields
record.statement:
For every p-adic field $K$ and every integer $r\ge 1$, the supremum $u_r(K)$ of the dimensions of anisotropic systems of $r$ quadratic forms over $K$ satisfies
\[
u_r(K)=4r.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16162), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of the genus of absolutely simple simply connected groups over finitely generated fields
record.statement: We conjecture that, for every absolutely simple simply connected algebraic group $G$ and every finitely generated field $K$ of good characteristic, the genus $\operatorname{gen}_K(G)$ is finite.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16162), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unramified degree-three cohomology for semisimple groups of mixed Dynkin types
record.statement: Let $G$ be a semisimple group of mixed Dynkin types (i.e., each component of the Dynkin diagram is of an arbitrary type) over an algebraically closed field. Is $H^3_{\mathrm{nr}}(F(BG))$ trivial?

record.title: Can the splitting ind-variety be chosen to be a variety?
record.statement: Let $k$ be an infinite field, let $n\ge 3$, let $M$ be a finite étale group scheme over $k$, and let $s\in H^n(k,M)$. Does there exist a smooth, geometrically integral $k$-variety $X$ such that, for every field extension $l/k$, the restriction of $s$ to $H^n(l,M)$ vanishes if and only if $X(l)\ne\varnothing$, and, whenever $X(l)\ne\varnothing$, the set $X(l)$ is Zariski-dense in $X$?

record.title: Property (T) for automorphism groups of free groups

record.title: Weak Tsirelson Conjecture
record.statement: For all $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, does $C_{qa}(n,k)=C_{qc}(n,k)$?

record.title: Sequential weak* continuity of countably additive states
record.statement: Given a state $g$ on a von Neumann algebra that is countably additive on projections, prove in ZFC that for every sequence $x_n\to x$ in the weak* topology, one has $g(x_n)\to g(x)$.

record.title: Ozawa’s entropy–variation inequality
record.statement:
Let $H(\varphi)$ denote the von Neumann entropy of $\varphi$ and define
\[
\delta(\varphi,\psi)=H\!\left(\frac{\varphi+\psi}{2}\right)-\frac{H(\varphi)+H(\psi)}{2}.
\]
Is it true that
\[
\lvert\varphi-\psi\rvert(A)\leq \bigl(8\,\delta(\varphi,\psi)\,(\varphi+\psi)(A^2)\bigr)^{1/2}
\]
for every $A\geq 0$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16163), page 81. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: 3-cores of random planar graphs
record.statement: Show that the 3-core of a random planar graph has a connected component of size $cn$, for some constant $c>0$, with high probability (probability tending to $1$ as $n\to\infty$). Here the random graph is chosen uniformly from the labelled planar graphs with $n$ vertices.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/23](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16164), page 74. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Just infinite Gelfand–Kirillov dimension for the full Witt algebra
record.statement: Let $W$ be the full Witt algebra over $\r\mathbb{C}$ with basis $\r\{e_n:n\in\mathbb{Z}\}$ and Lie bracket $[e_i,e_j]=(j-i)e_{i+j}$. Does $U(W)$ have just infinite Gelfand–Kirillov dimension; that is, for every nonzero two-sided ideal $I\subset U(W)$, is $\operatorname{GKdim}(U(W)/I)<\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/24](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16165), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Chebotarev density theorem in short intervals over number fields
record.statement:
Let $E/\mathbb{Q}$ be a finite Galois extension with Galois group $G$, and let $C\subseteq G$ be a conjugacy class. For every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, with $y=x^{\varepsilon}$, does
\[
\pi_C(x+y;E)-\pi_C(x;E)\sim \frac{|C|}{|G|}\frac{y}{\log x}\qquad (x\to\infty)
\]
hold, where $\pi_C(x;E)$ counts primes $p\le x$ whose Frobenius conjugacy class in $E/\mathbb{Q}$ equals $C$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16166), page 10. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite extensions of undecidable fields
record.statement: Is every finite extension of an undecidable field necessarily undecidable?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16166), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite extensions of decidable fields
record.statement: Is every finite field extension $L/K$ of a decidable field $K$ necessarily decidable? Here $K$ is called decidable when its first-order theory $\operatorname{Th}(K)$ in the language of rings $L_{\mathrm{ring}}=\{+,\cdot,0,1\}$ is decidable, equivalently when $\operatorname{Th}(K)$ has a recursive axiomatization.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16166), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Solvability of finite split embedding problems over $K(x)$ for large fields
record.statement: Every finite split embedding problem over $K(x)$ is solvable whenever $K$ is a large (ample) field.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16166), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of maximizing metrics for genus-zero surfaces with boundary
record.statement:
For every integer $k\ge 1$, there exists a smooth metric $g$ on a surface $M$ of genus $0$ with $k$ boundary components such that
\[
\sigma_1(g)L_g(\partial M)=\sigma^*(0,k),
\]
where $\sigma^*(0,k)=\sup_g \sigma_1(g)L_g(\partial M)$, with the supremum taken over all smooth metrics on $M$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16168), page 21. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Smooth rational real affine varieties with infinitely many real forms
record.statement: For every $d\ge 4$, there exist smooth rational real affine varieties of dimension $d$ which have at least countably infinitely many pairwise non-isomorphic real forms.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16169), page 25. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-rectifiable rational smooth embeddings of the real affine line
record.statement: For every integer $d\ge 5$, there exists a non-rectifiable rational smooth embedding of $\mathbb A^1_{\mathbb R}$ into $\mathbb A^2_{\mathbb R}$ whose associated projective curve $C\subset\mathbb P^2_{\mathbb R}$ is a rational nodal curve of degree $d$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/28](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16169), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Resolvent degree of the cover parametrizing lines on cubic surfaces
record.statement:
Let $H_{3,3}$ be the $4$-dimensional moduli space of smooth cubic surfaces in $\bbP^3$ modulo the action of $\bPGL(4)$, and let
$$
H_{3,3}(1)=\{(S,L): S\in H_{3,3},\ L\subset S\text{ a line}\}\longrightarrow H_{3,3}.
$$
This is a $27$-sheeted cover with group $W(E_6)\subset S_{27}$. The conjecture is
$$
\operatorname{RD}\bigl(H_{3,3}(1)\to H_{3,3}\bigr)=3.
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16171), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Certified bound for the first coexact 1-form eigenvalue of the Meyerhoff manifold
record.statement: Theorem 2 gives the numerically certified bound for manifold 1 in the Hodgson–Weeks census, also known as the Meyerhoff manifold, $$0.337<\lambda_1^*<0.339.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/31](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16406), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Baum–Connes conjecture with arbitrary coefficients
record.statement:
For a group $G$, the Baum–Connes conjecture with arbitrary coefficients asserts that, for every $G$-$C^*$-algebra $A$, the assembly map
$$\mu:K_*^{\mathrm{top}}(G;A)\longrightarrow K_*(A\rtimes_r G)$$
is an isomorphism.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16407), page 60. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Examples showing failure of the Koszul-module vanishing bound in small characteristic
record.statement:
In the setup above, with $n\ge 3$, $V$ an $n$-dimensional vector space over a field $k$, and $K\subseteq \bigwedge^2 V$, generate examples in characteristic satisfying $\operatorname{char}(k)\le n-3$ for which the equivalence

$$R(V,K)=\{0\}\Longleftrightarrow W_q(V,K)=0\ \text{for all }q\ge n-3$$

fails.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16408), page 7. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Multiplicity bound for points on theta divisors
record.statement: Let $(A,\Theta)$ be an indecomposable principally polarized abelian variety of dimension $g$. Is it true that, for every $x\in\Theta$, \[\operatorname{mult}_x\Theta\le \frac{g+1}{2}\,?\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16408), page 13. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The top-heavy conjecture for matroids
record.statement:
Let $M$ be a rank-$d$ matroid, and let $W_k$ be the number of rank-$k$ flats of $M$. Then
\[
W_k \le W_{d-k}
\]
for every $k\le \frac d2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16408), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Voisin’s conjecture on special subvarieties of holomorphic symplectic varieties
record.statement: Let $X$ be holomorphic symplectic of dimension $2n$. For all $0 \le i \le n$, there exist special subvarieties $Z \subset X$ in codimension $i$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16408), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Real period–index theorem for smooth integral real surfaces
record.statement: Let $S$ be a smooth integral surface over $\mathbb{R}$, and let $\alpha \in \operatorname{Br}(S) \subset \operatorname{Br}(\mathbb{R}(S))$ be such that $\alpha|_x = 0 \in \operatorname{Br}(\mathbb{R})$ for every $x \in S(\mathbb{R})$. Then $\operatorname{ind}(\alpha)=\operatorname{per}(\alpha)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16408), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Equality of the two bounded-plurisubharmonic hulls
record.statement:
Let $M$ be a complex manifold and let $w_0\in M$. Define
\[
A_{cb}(w_0)=\{w\in M: u(w)\leq u(w_0)\text{ for every }u\in\operatorname{PSH}_{cb}(M)\},
\]
and
\[
A_{cb}^{e}(w_0)=\{w\in M: u(w)=u(w_0)\text{ for every }u\in\operatorname{PSH}_{cb}(M)\},
\]
where $\operatorname{PSH}_{cb}(M)$ is the space of bounded continuous plurisubharmonic functions on $M$. Is
\[
A_{cb}(w_0)=A_{cb}^{e}(w_0)?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16412), page 22. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of irreducible holomorphic $(g,m)$-fiber bundles over finite Riemann surfaces
record.statement: **Conjecture.** Consider an arbitrary connected finite Riemann surface $X$, possibly of second kind. Up to isotopy, there are no more than finitely many irreducible holomorphic $(g,m)$-fiber bundles over $X$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16412), page 35. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Extension to the full PDE chemical model

record.title: Kosterlitz–Thouless transition in the loop \(O(n)\) model
record.statement:
**Conjecture.** On the hexagonal lattice, for every positive real \(n\le 2\), the loop \(O(n)\) model undergoes a Kosterlitz–Thouless phase transition at the critical threshold
\[
\alpha_c=\log\!\left(\sqrt{2+\sqrt{2-n}}\right).
\]

record.title: Height-variable covariance asymptotics in the two-dimensional Abelian sandpile model
record.statement:
Prove the conjecture that, for the infinite-volume sandpile measure $\nu$ on $\mathbb{Z}^2$, 
$$
\operatorname{Cov}_{\nu}\bigl(\eta(o)=i;\eta(x)=j\bigr)\sim a_{i,j}(\log^2|x|)|x|^{-4},\qquad |x|\to\infty,
$$
for every $i,j\in\{1,2,3\}$, where $o$ is the origin.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/4](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15989), page 42. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Applicability of the Lipschitz surface construction to percolation clusters
record.statement: It is however not clear if the Lipschitz surface construction can be applied to percolation clusters or other non-uniformly elliptic settings.

record.title: Strong Maximal Rank conjecture for genus 23
record.statement:
For a general smooth curve $C$ of genus $23$, and every linear series $L\in W^6_{26}(C)$, the multiplication map
$$
\varphi_L:\operatorname{Sym}^2 H^0(C,L)\longrightarrow H^0(C,L^{\otimes 2})
$$
is injective.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16417), page 24. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Mazur–Veech volumes as intersection numbers
record.statement:
For integers $g,n\ge 0$ with $2g-2+n>0$, and for every tuple $\mu=(m_1,\ldots,m_n)$ of nonnegative integers satisfying $\sum_{i=1}^n m_i=2g-2$, the following equality is conjectured:
\[
\operatorname{Vol}(\mu)=\frac{2(2\pi i)^{2g}}{(2g-3+n)!}\int_{\overline{\mathbb{P}\mathcal{H}(\mu)}}\xi^{2g-2}\prod_{i=1}^n\psi_i.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16417), page 53. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Beck’s bounded-length conjecture for strong Ramsey games
record.statement: For every integer $t$, does there exist a constant $c_t$ such that $L(K_t,n)\le c_t$ as $n\to\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16627), page 9. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Harbourne’s containment conjecture for symbolic powers
record.statement: Harbourne conjectured that, for the ideal $I$ of a finite set of points in $\cmathbb{P}^N_{\cmathbb{C}}$, one has $I^{(Nm-N+1)}\subseteq I^m$ for every $m\ge 1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16628), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Demailly's conjecture for finite sets of points in projective space
record.statement:
Let $I$ be a saturated ideal of a finite set of points in $\cmathbb{P}^N$. Then
$$\chat{\alpha}(I) \ge \frac{\alpha\!\left(I^{(m)}\right)+N-1}{m+N-1}$$
for all $m\ge 1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16628), page 11. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stable Harbourne containment conjecture
record.statement: Let $R$ be a regular ring and let $I$ be a radical ideal of big height $h$. Then, for all $n\gg 0$, $I^{(hn-h+1)}\subseteq I^n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/45](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16628), page 15. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture 2: Optimal coherence of five unit vectors in \(\mathbb{C}^3\)
record.statement:
**Conjecture.** The optimal coherence for \(n=5\) unit vectors in \(\mathbb{C}^3\) is
\[
\mu=\frac{\sqrt{13}-1}{6},
\]
achieved, for example, by any frame \(\Phi\) with Gram matrix
\[
\Phi^*\Phi=I+\mu\begin{bmatrix}
0&1&1&1&1\\
1&0&1&\omega&\omega^2\\
1&1&0&\omega^2&\omega\\
1&\omega^2&\omega&0&0\\
1&\omega&\omega^2&0&0
\end{bmatrix},
\qquad \omega=e^{2\pi i/3}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16629), page 9. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The Fickus Conjecture for complex equiangular tight frames
record.statement:
If an $n$-vector equiangular tight frame exists in $\[200~\mathbb{C}^d$, then at least one of the following divisibilities holds:
\[
d\mid (n-d)(n-1),\qquad n-d\mid d(n-1),\qquad n-1\mid d(n-d).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16629), page 10. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Vinzant’s Conjecture
record.statement:
Draw \(\operatorname{range}(\Phi^*)\) uniformly from \(\operatorname{Gr}(\mathbb{C}^{4d-5},d)\), and let \(p_d\) denote the probability that the map \([x]\mapsto |\Phi^*x|^2\) is injective, where \([x]=\{cx:|c|=1\}\). Then:

\[
\text{(a) } p_d<1\text{ for every }d,\qquad\text{and}\qquad
\text{(b) }\lim_{d\to\infty}p_d=0.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16629), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of maximal complex equiangular tight frames in every dimension
record.statement: For every positive integer $d$, do there exist vectors $v_1,,v_{d^2}in\mathbb{C}^d$ and a constant $\alpha$ such that $\|v_j\|=1$ for every $j$ and $|\langle v_j,v_k\rangle|=\alpha$ for all distinct $j,k$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16629), page 21. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Symmetry breaking in the optimal-insulation problem
record.statement: Let \a0$\a0\Omega=B_r(0)$ be a ball of radius $r>0$. There exists a constant $m_0>0$ such that, for every $0<m<m_0$, the eigenfunctions $u_m$ of the optimal-insulation problem are nonradial. In particular, the corresponding optimal insulating films have gaps: the zero set of every optimal film $\ell$ has positive Hausdorff measure on $\partial\Omega$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16631), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Cohn–Kumar-type minimization for soft lattice theta functions
record.statement: For every $\alpha>0$, the triangular lattice $\Lambda_1$ is the unique minimizer of $L\to\theta_{\mu_L+\nu_z}(\alpha)$ among periodic configurations (that is, unions of Bravais lattices) of unit density, provided $\mu$ and $\nu$ are completely monotone (CM) measures or are sufficiently rescaled around the lattice points.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16632), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rainbow paths in properly edge-coloured regular graphs
record.statement: For every integer $k\ge 3$, every simple $k$-regular properly $k$-edge-coloured graph contains a rainbow path of length $k-1$, where a path is rainbow if all its edges have different colours.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/50](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16633), page 48. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Imperfect-completeness 2-to-1 Games hardness theorem
record.statement: For every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $k\in\mathbb{N}$ such that $\operatorname{gap}$-$2$-to-$1$ Games$_k[1-\varepsilon,\varepsilon]$ is NP-hard; that is, it is NP-hard to distinguish $2$-to-$1$ Label-Cover instances of alphabet size at most $k$ having value at least $1-\varepsilon$ from those having value at most $\varepsilon$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16634), page 29. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A truly subquadratic 1.1-approximation for LCS
record.statement: Is there a $1.1$-approximation for LCS running in $O(n^{2-\\varepsilon})$ time, for some $\\varepsilon>0$? (Open for all alphabet sizes.)

record.title: Donkin’s conjecture on the restriction of tilting modules
record.statement:
In the notation of the report: for every prime characteristic $p$ and every $p$-alcove $A$ in the fundamental box, Donkin conjectures that

$$\widehat{P}_A \cong \left(T_{\widetilde{A}}\right)\!\restriction_{G_1T}.$$

Here the displayed assertion is the report’s statement (2).

record.title: Hernandez’s conjectural Kazhdan–Lusztig formula for quantum affine modules
record.statement:
**Conjecture 1 (Hernandez, 2004).** For monomial labels $m,m'\in(\mathcal M,\leq)$, one has
$$[M(m)]=[L(m)]+\sum_{m'<m}P_{m,m'}(1)[L(m')],$$
and the polynomials $P_{m,m'}(t)$ are positive. Here $M(m)$ is a standard module, $L(m)$ is the corresponding simple module, and $[L(m)]_t$ is required to specialize to $[L(m)]$ at $t=1$.
